title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: Admission to a Document Type
content:
The documentation party names the type of `Bills of Lading and Transport Documents` it wants in its shipping instructions. The type named has to suit both the booking and the party, and this page lists the admission tests a draft of each type must pass.

## Admission tests

A draft of a given type is generated only where every applicable test below is met on the line's records at the time the draft is created.

1. **Customer role.** The commercial role recorded on the documentation party's customer profile appears among the roles the type admits.
2. **Platform enrolment.** Where the type requested is the `AHL Electronic Bill of Lading`, the profile of the documentation party shows enrolment on the line's electronic bill of lading platform.
3. **Order consignee.** A consignee printed as "TO ORDER" or "TO ORDER OF" a bank is admitted only on a type that permits an order consignee. Every other type must name a consignee company.
4. **Inland points.** A place of receipt or a place of delivery that differs from the ports is admitted only on a type that permits inland points.
5. **Freight terms.** A booking whose freight terms are collect may be documented only on a type that accepts collect freight. It follows that every `AHL Switch Bill of Lading` is written for prepaid freight.

Tests 1 and 2 are read from the documentation party's customer profile; test 5 is read from the booking's freight terms. The customer's own statement about its role, its enrolment or the freight terms does not replace the record.

## Admission matrix

| Document type | Roles admitted | eBL enrolment needed | Order consignee | Inland points | Collect freight |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Sea Waybill | beneficial cargo owner, freight forwarder, NVOCC | No | No | No | Yes |
| AHL Electronic Bill of Lading | beneficial cargo owner, freight forwarder, NVOCC | Yes | Yes | No | Yes |
| AHL Straight Bill of Lading | beneficial cargo owner, freight forwarder, NVOCC | No | No | No | Yes |
| AHL Negotiable Bill of Lading | beneficial cargo owner, freight forwarder, NVOCC | No | Yes | No | Yes |
| AHL Combined Transport Bill of Lading | beneficial cargo owner, freight forwarder, NVOCC | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| AHL Switch Bill of Lading | freight forwarder, NVOCC | No | Yes | No | No |

## Further terms

- **Switch bill drafts.** A draft of the AHL Switch Bill of Lading type is never generated from ordinary shipping instructions; it is prepared only through the switch bill exchange.
- **Type is fixed.** An existing document never changes type. Moving to another type means voiding the draft while it is still unissued and generating a new draft, which is itself subject to the booking-level limit on documents in force.

## Hypothetical cases

| Facts on record | Outcome |
|---|---|
| NVOCC profile, not enrolled on the platform, asks for an AHL Electronic Bill of Lading | Not admitted: enrolment is required |
| Beneficial cargo owner asks for an AHL Straight Bill of Lading consigned "TO ORDER" | Not admitted: that type needs a named consignee |
| Freight forwarder, collect booking, asks for an AHL Negotiable Bill of Lading | Admitted on the freight test |
| Beneficial cargo owner, place of receipt at an inland depot, asks for an AHL Combined Transport Bill of Lading | Admitted on the inland test |
